title_en: Nanjing Power Automation Equipment General Factory v. Nanjing Tianyin Power Equipment Factory — unfair competition dispute

full_text_en:
Nanjing Power Automation Equipment General Factory

v. Nanjing Tianyin Power Equipment Factory — unfair competition dispute

Plaintiff: Nanjing Power Automation Equipment General Factory, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Shen Jianshi, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Shisong, Deputy Manager of the Sales Department of Nanjing Power Automation Equipment General Factory, Jiangsu Province.

Agent ad litem: Ma Shanquan, Attorney at Law, Shanghai Branch of Tongren Law Firm, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Nanjing Tianyin Power Equipment Factory, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Wang Jun, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Wang Weibing and Shen Zuoming, Legal Workers at the Jiangning County Legal Affairs Center, Jiangsu Province.

The plaintiff, Nanjing Power Automation Equipment General Factory, Jiangsu Province (hereinafter referred to as the Automation Factory), filed a lawsuit with the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province against the defendant, Nanjing Tianyin Power Equipment Factory, Jiangsu Province (hereinafter referred to as the Tianyin Factory), due to a dispute over unfair competition.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The defendant, Tianyin Factory, used our factory's name to promote and sell its products, which not only damaged our factory's reputation but also caused economic losses to our factory. We request the court to order the defendant to cease the infringement, publish an apology in the newspaper, and compensate our factory for economic losses of RMB 2.98 million.

Defendant's Defense: The facts alleged by the plaintiff are true, but this was done without authorization by our factory's business personnel. Upon learning of this, we stopped it. Moreover, our factory did not make any profit. Therefore, we can only express our apologies to the plaintiff and request the plaintiff's understanding.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court found the following facts after trial:

On March 13, 1995, the defendant, Tianyin Factory, entered into a contract with Xinjiang Power Supply Bureau for the supply of four units of microcomputer protection screens, with a total price of RMB 560,000. Tianyin Factory shipped two units, and the product nameplates indicated the manufacturer as the plaintiff, Automation Factory. After the Automation Factory investigated this matter in Xinjiang, Tianyin Factory shipped the two protection screens back. In the second half of 1995, Tianyin Factory sold to Jiangsu Longyuan Electric Power Equipment Co., Ltd. nine units of MLP-106 type microcomputer line protection screens and three units of MLP-107 type, with a total price of RMB 630,000, at an average selling price of RMB 52,500 per unit. Tianyin Factory admitted that these 12 protection screens originally had nameplates indicating the manufacturer as the Automation Factory, which had already been removed. Tianyin Factory had four other protection screens that had been produced but not yet affixed with nameplates.

It was further found: The MLP-106 type product produced by the defendant, Tianyin Factory, is identical to the GXW11-106 type product of the plaintiff, Automation Factory, which the Automation Factory sells at RMB 117,600 per unit; the MLP-107 type product produced by Tianyin Factory is identical to the GXW11-107 type product of the Automation Factory, which the Automation Factory sells at RMB 91,200 per unit. The profit margin for both of the above products of the Automation Factory is over 30%, and Tianyin Factory raised no objection to this. The Automation Factory incurred a total of RMB 81,249.18 in expenses for investigation, evidence collection, and other activities to initiate this lawsuit. In May 1994, Tianyin Factory purchased 16 transceivers from Yangzhou Telecommunication Instrument Factory.

The above facts are confirmed by the supply contract signed between the defendant, Tianyin Factory, and Xinjiang Power Supply Bureau, the sales invoices issued by Tianyin Factory, the investigation report and related photographs of the plaintiff, Automation Factory, the product price list of the Automation Factory, the statement published by the Automation Factory in *China Electric Power News*, the expense receipts of the Automation Factory, the court's investigation records, and the trial records.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court held that:

Article 99, paragraph 2, and Article 101 of the *General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China* stipulate that legal persons enjoy the rights to name and reputation. In a market economy, the visibility of an enterprise determines its position in market competition. Products produced by enterprises with high visibility have a higher market share compared to identical products produced by other enterprises. Therefore, the name of an enterprise with high visibility is not only a civil right granted to an enterprise legal person by the *General Principles of the Civil Law*, but also implies the property rights of the enterprise. Electrical products have high quality requirements. The visibility of the plaintiff, Automation Factory, was earned through the quality of its products. Article 5, paragraph (3) of the *Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China* provides that business operators shall not "use, without authorization, the enterprise name or personal name of others, leading people to mistakenly believe that the goods are those of others." The defendant, Tianyin Factory, was originally a processing and collaboration unit for components of the Automation Factory's products. In order to bring its own finished products to the market, it did not hesitate to use the unfair competition means of "using the enterprise name of another" to promote its products. This conduct not only infringed upon the Automation Factory's right to its name, damaged the Automation Factory's reputation and interests, but also disrupted the normal market competition order and posed a potential threat to the safe use of electrical products by users. For this, Tianyin Factory shall bear corresponding civil liability. Article 43 of the *General Principles of the Civil Law* provides: "An enterprise legal person shall bear civil liability for the business activities of its legal representative and other staff members." The defense of Tianyin Factory that using the Automation Factory's name to sell products was an unauthorized act of its business personnel and that the factory should not bear civil liability cannot be established. The defendant, Tianyin Factory, used the visibility of the plaintiff, Automation Factory, to sell its own products. Its unfair competition conduct caused economic losses to the Automation Factory. Pursuant to Article 20 of the *Anti-Unfair Competition Law*, it shall compensate. The infringing products produced by Tianyin Factory require a transceiver as an accessory, which is only produced by Yangzhou Telecommunication Instrument Factory. It has been proven that Tianyin Factory purchased 16 transceivers from Yangzhou Telecommunication Instrument Factory and produced 16 protection screens, of which 12 were sold under the Automation Factory's name, which shall be determined as constituting infringement.

The visibility of the infringed party in the market is cultivated through substantial investment of funds and intellectual labor. The infringer, by using the visibility of others for unfair competition, can reap the benefits without significant investment. The defendant, Tianyin Factory, admitted to an infringing profit of only a few thousand yuan. Determining the amount of compensation based on this is not conducive to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the infringed party and is insufficient to punish the illegal conduct. Tianyin Factory used a price-cutting method to sell infringing products using the Automation Factory's name, engaging in unfair market competition with the Automation Factory, which inevitably affects the normal product sales of the Automation Factory. Therefore, based on the profit that the Automation Factory could have obtained from producing 12 units of the same products as the infringing ones, Tianyin Factory shall compensate the Automation Factory for economic losses of RMB 399,600, which conforms to the principle of fairness.

Article 20 of the *Anti-Unfair Competition Law* also provides that a business operator who violates the provisions of this Law shall bear the reasonable expenses paid by the injured business operator for investigating the unfair competition conduct of the said business operator that infringes upon its legitimate rights and interests. In this case, the plaintiff, Automation Factory, provided the court with expense receipts totaling RMB 124,643.18, including RMB 40,143.18 for travel and evidence collection expenses incurred for investigating the infringement, RMB 32,000 for publishing a statement in *China Electric Power News*, and RMB 52,500 for hiring lawyers. According to the lawyer fee standards formulated by the Ministry of Justice, the lawyer fee for this case should be RMB 9,106. The additional amount of RMB 43,394 for hiring lawyers was the result of negotiations between the Automation Factory and the lawyer and is unrelated to the infringing conduct of the defendant, Tianyin Factory. Therefore, the reasonable expenses in this case are RMB 81,249.18, which shall be compensated by Tianyin Factory.

The conduct of the defendant, Tianyin Factory, in selling products by passing them off as those of the plaintiff, Automation Factory, also adversely affected the reputation of the Automation Factory. Pursuant to Article 122 of the *General Principles of the Civil Law*, Tianyin Factory shall publicly publish an apology in an industry newspaper to eliminate the effects of the infringement. In summary, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

1. The defendant, Tianyin Factory, shall publish an apology statement in *China Electric Power News* within 30 days of the judgment taking effect, and the wording shall be subject to review by the court.

2. The defendant, Tianyin Factory, shall compensate the plaintiff, Automation Factory, for economic losses in the amount of RMB 480,849.18, to be paid in full within 30 days of the judgment taking effect.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, neither party filed an appeal within the statutory period.
